title: FREE: Fast and Robust Vision Language Models with Early Exits

layout.note: Nine equal rounded cards in three rows of three, separated by whitespace. Each card stacks a photo at the top, then question bubbles aligned to the right with person icons and answer boxes aligned to the left with robot icons; the last three cards hold a single captioning prompt and answer.

lesson: Show a token-level property, such as the layer at which a word is decided, by recolouring words in real chat examples inside a uniform grid of photo-plus-dialogue cards.
